newsitem.title: CHINA: China Strategic buys Star Telecom shares.
newsitem.headline: China Strategic buys Star Telecom shares.

text.p: China Strategic Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday it has exercised an option to buy 144.59 million shares in Star Telecom International Holding Ltd from Star chairman Wong Kam Fu at HK$2.00 per share.

After the acquisition, China Strategic's holding in Star Telecom increased to 234.10 million shares, representing about 37.16 percent of the company's existing issued share capital, it said in a statement.
Under the takeovers and mergers rule, China Strategic was obligated to make a general offer for the Star Telecom shares, it said.
The company said another announcement would be made as soon as the terms of the offer were finalised.
Wong and his wife's shareholding in Star Telecom fell to 145.05 million shares, or 23.03 percent, after the deal.
Trading in shares of China Strategic and Star Telecom remained suspended pending further announcements, the company said.
The two companies' shares have been suspended since June 23.
